posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Happy Mini-Pack 1 day! The first expansion pack is now available on Google Play, Amazon Appstore, iOS, and Steam. You can also buy Expansion Season Pass 1 which gets you the first 4 expansions and 3 mini-packs as they come out.

The app is now live in the App Store, so go get it there too!

Onward to Rook City!

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
@xThe Killswitch: Priority and scheduling are not the same thing. It's a high priority for us and we are working to make it available when it's ready. It is not tied to any particular expansion pack release. We will likely have a public beta for it as well.

@Donner: Thanks! We're aware of that and hope to get that resolved with Valve. We put a link in the description, and you can see it from the Mini-Pack 1 page too, or from the in-game store.
